i.norm: Verifies that the Levenshtein distance between two CharBuffer sequences containing null characters and 'f' is correctly computed when a threshold of 7 is used. left = "\0\0\0f\0\0\0" (length 7: 'f' at index 3) right = "\0\0f\0\0\0ff" (length 8: 'f' at indices 2, 6, 7) Expected distance: 3 (within the threshold of 7)
left sequence: null chars with 'f' at position 3 (length 7)
right sequence: null chars with 'f' at positions 2, 6, 7 (length 8)
